stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in GSE319093: every sequenced sample is a sedentary/basal, hypoxia, high-fructose-diet, AAV-injury or C2C12 sample. Exercise in the paper (weighted swimming test, S2.5/S3.1.p4) was only a phenotypic readout and was never sequenced, so an exercise effect on gene expression cannot be identified.
